Animal welfare and a few reminders
The desk is glad to help this week

Animal Travel Notice

Travelers need to check pet plans early and speak up at once if anything feels unclear or unsafe. Aurelia Skyways wants each animal to travel with care, calm, and the right support.

Please keep documents, carrier details, and feeding notes ready before you arrive. The Companion Animal Travel Desk reviews each case closely, and the senior coordinator oversees daily service choices. If a passenger is worried, supervisors listen carefully and work to lower stress for both the traveler and the pet. This applies whether you are moving a cat, a dog, or Teddy.

Aurelia Skyways asks travelers to share health needs clearly, keep carriers secure, and follow staff guidance without delay. Small problems can become larger fast, so contact the desk as soon as you notice a change in your plans or your pet's condition. The team will do what it can to protect comfort and safety while keeping the trip on track.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you travel.
